title: Verdict
description: Schema for policy engine verdict decision on an asset.

decision_id.description: Unique identifier for this policy decision.

asset_id.description: Identifier of the asset being evaluated.

verdict.description: Verdict produced by the policy engine.

reasons.description: List of explicit reasons or finding summaries supporting this verdict.

policy_id.description: Identifier of the policy used for this decision.

policy_version.description: Version number of the policy used.

decided_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the decision was rendered.
